propositions: Bridge cannot serve multiple tracker projects against one codebase because JiraConfig.project, inbound JQL construction, and outbound mutation dispatch are each hard-wired to a single project scalar.

A shared ticket store with project-to-repos mappings at .bridge_state/projects.json enables N repos and N tracker projects to coordinate without per-repo project lists, preventing diff-as-deletion failure when multiple repos fetch different project subsets against a shared prev_snapshot.json.

Ticket project field is tri-state (absent=legacy, empty=never sync, explicit key=sync there) and migrates with zero event writes by resolving absent against a store-seeded legacy default via an idempotent ensure unit.

Multi-project inbound fetch fan-outs over the configured project set with per-project enrichment (parent, comment, issuelink maps) merged into a shared snapshot, preserving enrichment data for all projects.
Outbound dispatch per-ticket project and cross-project guard relaxed to set membership allows explicit project targeting while rejecting mutations outside the configured set.
A store holding >1 project receives multi-project-bridge capability stamp on .store-compat.json and binaries lacking it fail closed; single-project stores remain writable by older binaries.
